id: title:adboio:price kimi k3 through routed provider

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration support for a new LLM model ('kimi-k3') and its associated cost overrides, potentially enabling billing or routing capabilities for this model in PostHog's gateway.
review.reason: The change adds a new model entry to the cost alias mapping, removes a redundant entry, and imports a cost overrides module. This represents a configuration and dependency update rather than a substantive behavioral or systemic improvement. The tier is assigned based on the presence of these configuration changes, not on demonstrated benefit or broader capability.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and implementation status of the cost overrides and billing configuration are not demonstrated; this could be a preparatory or cleanup-only change.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new model entry to the cost alias mapping.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new LLM model to the gateway's cost alias configuration, potentially enabling billing or routing for this model.

observations.behavior: Removes a redundant model entry from the cost override dictionary.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a redundant model entry from the gateway's cost override configuration, potentially cleaning up the billing or routing configuration.

observations.behavior: Adds an import for the model cost overrides module.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds an import for the model cost overrides module, potentially enabling the use of this module in the test.
